verdict.rationale: Parsec's docs claim near-zero latency, up to 240 FPS (60 FPS at 4K), and 4:4:4 color. It also supports interactive peripherals: keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and Wacom pressure and tilt. Community users independently report smooth, near-60fps remote desktop and even gaming over 4G, so it is clearly usable for interactive work rather than passive viewing. missing for 10: any explicit evidence that the stream is hardware-encoded (GPU encoder), measured latency figures.
